title: A held request carries an options comment that stays last, and /accept from a maintainer hands it to the plan worker
covers: an issue held because it changes what exists gets one options comment, written by the bot, as its last comment
a later comment moves it to the end again, and there is still only one
/accept removes the hold on the request and starts the plan worker, and the options comment changes to match the plan that waits for approval

a reply that started the issue worker before the command does not bring the hold back when that run ends, whoever the maintainer is to the workflow token: the command is recorded by a comment of the bot, which issue triage reads

issue.title: Drop the widgets command, flattenTree covers it (accept)
issue.body:
## Problem

The `widgets` command in the app and `listWidgets` in the library do what `flattenTree` plus a filter already do.

## Proposal

Delete `listWidgets` and the `widgets` command and point people at `flattenTree(root).filter(...)`.

## Acceptance

- `listWidgets` and the `widgets` command are gone.
- The remaining tests pass.
